question: What theoretical capacity does the paper's definition of 1C correspond to, and what first-discharge capacity does its share of theoretical capacity at 0.1C imply?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%1c%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%theoretical%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%0.1c%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%0.1 c%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%capacity%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 55 AND 70 OR (page=5 AND id IN ('p5.L62','p5.L63')) ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(l1.text,'C = ([0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) * CAST(regexp_extract(l2.text,'([0-9]+)% of theoretical',1) AS DOUBLE) / 100 AS first_discharge_mAh_gS FROM lines l1, lines l2 WHERE l1.id='p5.L62' AND l2.id='p5.L63'
